entry_state: Partial write-off removes identified gross and allowance amounts without another expense. Later favourable receipts create signed allowance gains. Noncredit catch-up stays separate; fractional-date factors require certified bounds rather than rounded values labelled exact.
exit_state: The dated schedule retains every cash, write-off and clearing origin. A nonrational original rate is enclosed using positive-receipt monotonicity, and the same rate bracket propagates through all dates. Numerical uncertainty is not a distribution over economic histories.
findings: The dated-method conclusion retains terminal allowance clearing as an origin and rejects incomplete reports.
The new rate is the positive root of 100x squared minus 50x minus 60; the displayed radical and approximate rate agree.
Strictly positive times, nonnegative receipts and at least one positive receipt justify the negative derivative. Mixed-sign receipts are expressly excluded.
The shared original rate is not refitted after credit changes. No new defect observed.
